onboarding.signInDefault: Create your personal account or sign in with your passkey, then link your device.
onboarding.title: Your FlowFlow account
onboarding.lead: Your account, devices and Premium access.
onboarding.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account using the email address that received this link. Your passkey is still required.
onboarding.inviteHint: Accept this invitation with the invited email address. It verifies your address but does not grant Premium or membership of a space.
onboarding.verifyHint: Confirm this link to verify the email address of the account shown below.
onboarding.emailUnverified: Your email has not been verified yet.
onboarding.emailSent: Verification email sent. Open its link in this browser.
onboarding.linked: Your account is linked to your devices.
onboarding.linkInstructions: In FlowFlow on iPhone or Mac: Settings → Account → Generate link code. Copy the code, open the linking page below, and paste it. Return to the app to check the result.
onboarding.installHint: App not installed? Install FlowFlow, then return to this page. Pairing is for your own devices, not for inviting another person.
onboarding.premiumHint: Premium requires administrator approval. No payment is requested. An invitation does not activate Premium.
onboarding.optionalHint: If you wish, connect your Hermes instance to a FlowFlow space. The guide explains how to choose its permissions and verify the connection.
onboarding.request_pending: Your Premium request is awaiting administrator approval.
onboarding.request_approved: Your last request was approved. Your current access is shown above.
onboarding.request_denied: Your last request was declined. You can request access again.
onboarding.invitationAccepted: Invitation accepted and email verified. Continue with device linking if needed.
onboarding.missingToken: No invitation or verification link is available in this tab. Open the original email link. If you already completed it, check your account status below.
onboarding.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot keep the link during sign-in. Sign in, then reopen the original email link in this tab.

errors.unknown: Unable to complete this action. Check your connection and retry.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This action is not permitted. Refresh your session and retry.
errors.account_not_linked: Link your device account before requesting Premium.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email before requesting Premium.
errors.premium_already_active: Premium is already active. Refresh your account status.
errors.token_invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Check your account status or request a new email.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign out and use the invited account.
errors.email_delivery_not_configured: Email delivery is not configured yet. Contact the administrator.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait a minute before trying again.
errors.linkExpired: The code is invalid or expired. Generate a new code in the app.
errors.alreadyLinked: An account is already linked. No accounts were merged. Check the existing link before continuing.

auth.registerLead: A passkey instead of a password.
auth.noPasskey: No passkey on this device - register or use another device.
auth.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.

link.title: Link a device
link.lead: Paste the code shown in the FlowFlow app to link this account to your devices.

overview.emptyLead: Link a device from the FlowFlow app to see your account here.

devices.none: No device on this account yet.

profile.tapHint: Tap the avatar to change the photo.
profile.photoSpec: JPEG, PNG or WebP · 256 KB max · shown with your name on shared notes.

home.title: My account
home.unavailable: This information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
home.deviceNamesHint: Names are set in the FlowFlow app’s sync settings.
home.premiumDescription: Your account has Premium access. No payment is currently requested.
